nodes.label: Role-Based Access Control (Admin vs Standard User)
nodes.rationale: Admins see all projects via GET /project; standard users are restricted to their organization via GET /project/organization/:id.
nodes.norm_label: role-based access control (admin vs standard user)

nodes.label: Single-Session Enforcement & Multi-Device Auto-Logout
nodes.rationale: Synchronized with backend currentJwtToken; a login elsewhere invalidates the token, the device catches the 401, clears credentials, alerts and routes to Login.

nodes.label: Developer Server Selector
nodes.rationale: Physical devices cannot reach localhost on the dev machine, so presets for Localhost, Android Emulator (10.0.2.2:3000), LAN IP (DEV_MACHINE_IP) and remote servers are offered.

nodes.label: Multi-Basemap Switcher (OSM, Esri Satellite, CARTO Dark)
nodes.norm_label: multi-basemap switcher (osm, esri satellite, carto dark)

nodes.label: HTML5 Canvas Vector Renderer (L.canvas)
nodes.rationale: Rendering onto an accelerated canvas avoids DOM/SVG node bottlenecks that degrade mobile performance.

nodes.label: Viewport-Aware Spatial Culling
nodes.rationale: In-memory spatial index renders only geometries intersecting the visible area plus 30% padding, for projects with thousands of shapes.

nodes.label: Time-Sliced Chunked Rendering
nodes.rationale: 150-feature batches via requestAnimationFrame/setTimeout keep 60 FPS during pan/zoom.

nodes.label: Level of Detail & Vertex Simplification
nodes.rationale: smoothFactor 1.5 and suppression of micro-points when zoomed out reduce rendering cost.

nodes.label: GIS Filters (Geometry Type, Data Source Origin, Obj Name)
nodes.norm_label: gis filters (geometry type, data source origin, obj name)

nodes.label: Offline Local Persistence (AsyncStorage per project)
nodes.rationale: Captures stored under smartown_survey_captures_<projectId> for resilient offline fieldwork.
